corrections.reason: Amharic contrastive particle ያስ ('and what about that one?'), parallel to ያስ on the next line; 6th-order ስ was misread as 4th-order ሳ.
The printed glyph is ከዚህም ('different from this too'), where a faint right loop on ም caused it to be misread as ን.
Canonical Ge'ez citation (Isa 53:12 / Mark 15:28) ተኈለቈ ምስለ ጌጋያን ('he was numbered with the transgressors'); 4th-order ጋ was misread as 2nd-order ጉ.
The printed glyph in the image is clearly 2nd-order ሁ (ሁነ) with the lower-right horizontal stroke.
In the image the printed word is ኀደገኒየ (quoting ኀደገኒ from the Gospel verse: 'ኀደገኒየ ሲል በኀዳጋኑ ተገብቶ ይጸልያል'); ኒ was misread as ብ.
